timeline.summary: Ch. Krishna Murthy, Ch. Manjula, Ch. Siddartha, and Cluk declared no new encumbrances on VCL shares as of 03.04.2026 under SEBI’s Regulation 31(4).
Vishnu Chemicals announced shareholder approval for the re-appointment of Ch. Siddartha as Joint Managing Director for 5 years.
Vishnu Chemicals announced shareholder approval for the re-appointment of Ch. Siddartha as Joint Managing Director for 5 years via postal ballot.
Vishnu Chemicals extended the temporary maintenance shutdown at its Visakhapatnam Parwada plant.
Vishnu Chemicals said its Visakhapatnam Parwada plant, under maintenance since mid-April 2026, resumed full operations on May 12, 2026.
Vishnu Chemicals reported Q4FY25 consolidated PAT of ₹43.40 Cr on revenue of ₹450.31 Cr; FY26 PAT of ₹142.27 Cr; and recommended a ₹0.30 dividend.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹450.31 Cr (+14.7% YoY), net profit ₹43.4 Cr (+11.5% YoY).
Vishnu Chemicals reported FY26 consolidated revenue of ₹1,609.7 Cr and PAT of ₹142.2 Cr, achieving record annual performance.
Vishnu Chemicals temporarily halted operations at its Visakhapatnam Parwada plant from October 28, 2026, to synchronize forward integration and new capex.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹429.53 Cr (+7.1% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹35.57 Cr.
